_title: Ask the Witch – Book of Answers App
_description: Rub the cauldron, hold the grimoire or shake your phone — let the witch answer your question. 200 answers, a daily omen, 75 languages. A free entertainment app.
_keywords: ask the witch, book of answers, fortune app, daily omen, witch fortune, yes no fortune, magic book
hero_lead: Rub the cauldron, hold the grimoire or shake your phone — let the witch answer your question. 200 answers, a daily omen and a fate journal keep your curiosity fed. For entertainment only.
how_desc: There are three magical ways to ask the witch — whichever you pick, an answer is waiting.
how_1_d: Rub the witch's cauldron with your finger and let a magic scroll bring your answer.
how_2_d: Think of your question, hold the Book of Answers and let go; the page it opens to is your answer.
how_3_d: Shake your phone or swirl the crystal ball's mist with your finger for a quick yes-or-no answer.
how_4_d: One of 200 answers appears, colored according to its meaning.
feat_desc: A fun companion for curious moments, midnight chats and hanging out with friends.
f_1_d: Rub the cauldron, hold the grimoire, or shake your phone / swirl the crystal ball — every way brings you one of 200 answers.
f_2_d: A new card every day: your lucky number, lucky color, lucky hour and the real moon phase computed on your device. Keep your streak alive!
f_3_d: Type the same question again on the same day and the witch won't forget — she gives you the same answer.
f_4_d: Add the answers you get to your favorites, and come back to read them anytime.
f_5_d: Share an answer you like as a stylish image card through your phone's share sheet.
f_6_d: Download and start right away, no account needed; the interface is in 75 languages.
screens_desc: Sample screens of the cauldron, the grimoire and today's omen.
cta_desc: Ask the Witch is free. Download it now and ask your question.
